summary: AFS SenSub Corp., as depositor, and AmeriCredit Financial Services (d/b/a GM Financial), as sponsor, closed an auto-loan ABS issuance on October 14, 2026 through GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4, registering seven note classes totaling roughly $1.016 billion alongside an asset-backed certificate. Coupons range from 4.258% (Class A-1) to 5.64% (Class C). The 8-K was filed solely to satisfy the registration statement undertaking to furnish unqualified validity and tax opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP, attached as Exhibits 5.1 and 8.1. Routine shelf takedown; no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
